_note: Nameplate animation. Opacities 0 to 1 unless named otherwise.

flash._note: The star flash over "flash" title plates, a loop of loop_frames frames at 60 per second. stars: each draws the title's Small.png from frame `from` to frame `to` at (x, y) in 1280x720 units (drawn 1.5 times larger, for 1920x1080) or at y_px, a y in 1920x1080 pixels; its scale is `scale`, or with fade_frames it shrinks from `scale` by scale / fade_frames per frame from `from`. Entries draw in this order.

slash._note: Shines/Slash.png sweeps right by travel_x (1280x720 units) every travel_frames frames, from frame `from` to `to`, at y; its opacity, in 0-255 units, starts at start_opacity (shown capped at full) and drops by opacity_drop_per_frame.

big_star._note: The title's Big.png at (x, y) in 1280x720 units, from frame `from` to `to`: it grows from nothing by 1 / grow_frames per frame until frame grow_until, then fades by fade_per_frame (0-255 units) per frame.

rarity_stars._note: The rarity stars' glitter. Each star's patch pulses additively, peaking at shine_opacity once per shine_period_ms, each star shine_phase_step radians after the previous one. Each star's two glints blink in turn once per glint_period_ms (each star glint_phase_step of a period after the previous one, the second glint glint_pair_phase of a period after the first), turning glint_turn_deg over a blink and growing from glint_min_scale by up to glint_scale_grow; a blink weaker than glint_min_blink is not drawn. The clock wraps at time_wrap_ms, a multiple of both periods.
